PROTEIN.names: Essential identifier for web search and represents the protein's common names across different organisms.
PROTEIN.ids: Essential identifier for web search, specifically UniProtKB IDs, which are standard protein identifiers.

PUBLICATION.pmid: Unique identifier for the publication, essential for searching and linking to external databases.
PUBLICATION.InterPro_Publication__title: Title of the publication, providing a summary of the content.
PUBLICATION.InterPro_Publication__year: Year of publication, useful for filtering and understanding the context of the research.
PUBLICATION.InterPro_Publication__journal: Journal where the publication appeared, indicating the source and potential scope.
PUBLICATION.InterPro_Publication__authors: Authors of the publication, relevant for attribution and expertise.

PROTEIN_DOMAIN.InterPro_Domain__id: Unique identifier for the domain, crucial for linking to external databases and literature.
PROTEIN_DOMAIN.InterPro_Domain__structure_db_links: Links to protein structure databases (e.g., PDB), relevant for structural analysis and understanding protein function.
PROTEIN_DOMAIN.InterPro_Domain__external_docs: Links to external databases and resources (e.g., EC, REACTOME, METACYC) providing functional information and context.

FAMILY.names: Provides the name(s) of the protein family, crucial for identification and literature search.
FAMILY.ids: Provides unique identifiers for the protein family, useful for database lookups and linking to other resources.
FAMILY.InterPro_Family__external_docs: Links to external documentation (e.g., REACTOME, PROSITE) providing detailed information about the family, relevant for research.
FAMILY.InterPro_Family__key_species: Indicates the key species associated with this protein family, relevant for microbiome, proteome, and metaproteome research.
FAMILY.InterPro_Family__structure_db_links: Links to protein structure databases (e.g., PDB), important for structural analysis and understanding function.
FAMILY.InterPro_Family__protein_count: Indicates the number of proteins belonging to this family, providing context on its prevalence.

TERM.GeneOntology_Term__name: Represents the name of the Gene Ontology term, crucial for identifying the biological process or function.
TERM.GeneOntology_Term__id: Unique identifier for the Gene Ontology term, essential for precise referencing and web search.
TERM.GeneOntology_Term__def: Provides the definition of the Gene Ontology term, explaining its meaning and context.

METADATA.names: Essential identifier for web search and representing the entity.
METADATA.ids: Important for unique identification and linking to external databases.

ENZYME.names: Essential identifier for web search and common reference.
ENZYME.ids: Essential identifier for web search and common reference (EC number).
ENZYME.ENZYME_Enzyme__official_name: Specific name of the enzyme, relevant for detailed information.
ENZYME.ENZYME_Enzyme__id: Specific ID of the enzyme (EC number), relevant for detailed information.
ENZYME.ENZYME_Enzyme__catalyticActivities: Describes the function of the enzyme, highly relevant to proteome/metaproteome research.

HOMOLOGOUSSUPERFAMILY.InterPro_HomologousSuperfamily__id: Specific identifier for the homologous superfamily.
HOMOLOGOUSSUPERFAMILY.InterPro_HomologousSuperfamily__protein_: Provides information about the prevalence of the superfamily.

PTM.InterPro_PTM__name: Essential identifier for the PTM, crucial for searching and linking to specific modifications.
PTM.InterPro_PTM__id: Specific identifier for the PTM within the InterPro database.
PTM.InterPro_PTM__external_docs: Links to external databases (e.g., PROSITE, REACTOME) providing further information about the PTM.
PTM.InterPro_PTM__key_species: Indicates the species in which this PTM is found, relevant for proteome/metaproteome research.

DRUG.names: Essential for web search and identifying drug treatments.
DRUG.ids: Provides unique identifiers (RxNorm, ChEMBL) for accurate knowledge graph linking.
DRUG.DGIdb_Drug__sources: Captures data provenance from databases like ChEMBL and RxNorm for research validation.

RNA.ids: Primary unique identifier for the RNA molecule, essential for web search and precise sequencing analysis.
RNA.rna_type: Classifies the RNA species (e.g., miRNA), critical for interpreting sequencing data and functional context.
RNA.DISEASES_Gene__id: Links the RNA to specific diseases, directly supporting research on associated treatments and literature.

TAXON.names: Primary identifier for human-readable search and literature association.
TAXON.ids: Standardized NCBI Taxonomy IDs enable cross-referencing with proteome and microbiome databases.

GENE.names: Primary gene symbol for web search and general identification.
GENE.ids: Standard HGNC unique identifier for precise gene resolution.
GENE.DGIdb_Gene__uniprotkb_id: Links gene to protein sequences for proteome and metaproteome analysis.

DISEASE.ids: Unique Disease Ontology identifiers enable linking disease entities to external literature and treatment databases.
DISEASE.names: Standardized disease names facilitate searchability and human interpretation within the research context.

CLINICAL_TRIAL.ClinicalTrials_gov_Trial__id: Unique identifier for web search and entity linking.
CLINICAL_TRIAL.ClinicalTrials_gov_Trial__official_title: Descriptive name of the clinical trial.
CLINICAL_TRIAL.ClinicalTrials_gov_Trial__interventions_: Relevant to associated treatments and interventions.
CLINICAL_TRIAL.ClinicalTrials_gov_Trial__conditions_mes: Relevant to the medical conditions being studied.
CLINICAL_TRIAL.ClinicalTrials_gov_Trial__biospecimen_de: Relevant to sequencing analysis and sample collection for proteome/metaproteome research.
CLINICAL_TRIAL.ClinicalTrials_gov_Trial__phase: Indicates the stage of clinical development.

COMPOUND.CMAUP_Ingredient__pref_name: Preferred name for human-readable search and identification.
COMPOUND.CMAUP_Ingredient__chembl_id: Standard identifier for drug and compound data linking.
COMPOUND.CMAUP_Ingredient__pubchem_cid: Standard identifier for chemical structure and data linking.
COMPOUND.CMAUP_Ingredient__inchi_key: Unique chemical structure identifier for exact matching.
COMPOUND.CMAUP_Ingredient__molecular_weight: Physical property relevant for compound characterization in research.

LOCATION.ClinicalTrials_gov_Location__facility_na: Acts as the primary name identifier for the location, facilitating web search and linking to specific treatment centers.
LOCATION.ClinicalTrials_gov_Location__status: Provides context on the availability of associated clinical trials, relevant to treatment research.

INTERVENTION.ClinicalTrials_gov_Intervention__name: Essential identifier for web search and entity resolution.
INTERVENTION.ClinicalTrials_gov_Intervention__other_n: Captures synonyms and alternative names for comprehensive literature search.
INTERVENTION.ClinicalTrials_gov_Intervention__type: Categorizes the intervention (e.g., Drug) for filtering treatment types.
INTERVENTION.ClinicalTrials_gov_Intervention__descrip: Provides context on administration and dosage relevant to treatment protocols.

OUTCOME.__id: Primary unique identifier for the node within the knowledge graph.
OUTCOME.ClinicalTrials_gov_Outcome____id: External identifier enabling web search and linking to ClinicalTrials.gov literature.
OUTCOME.ClinicalTrials_gov_Outcome__measure: Details specific pharmacokinetic metrics relevant to treatment analysis.
OUTCOME.ClinicalTrials_gov_Outcome__description: Provides context on the outcome measurements and sample collection.
OUTCOME.ClinicalTrials_gov_Outcome__time_frame: Indicates the duration of outcome measurement for treatment efficacy.

ALIGNMENT.names: Essential identifier for web search and entity resolution using RefSeq accessions.
ALIGNMENT.RefSeq_SequenceComparison__experiment: Contains PMIDs linking alignment data to associated literature research.
ALIGNMENT.RefSeq_Match__pct_identity_ungap: Key metric for evaluating sequencing analysis quality and alignment accuracy.
ALIGNMENT.RefSeq_Match__e_value: Statistical significance indicator for validating alignment reliability.
ALIGNMENT.RefSeq_SequenceComparison__note: Provides clinical context and phenotypic details relevant to associated treatments.
ALIGNMENT.RefSeq_cDNAMatch__target_accession: Links genomic alignment to specific transcriptome entries for proteome research.
ALIGNMENT.RefSeq_cDNAMatch__qtaxid: Taxonomy identifier crucial for microbiome and metaproteome classification.

REGULATORY_ELEMENT.search_names: Essential identifier for web search and entity resolution.
REGULATORY_ELEMENT.RefSeq_ProteinBindingSite__bound_moiety: Links regulatory elements to specific proteins, supporting proteome research.
REGULATORY_ELEMENT.RefSeq_ResponseElement__note: Identifies response to hormones or drugs, relevant for treatment analysis.
REGULATORY_ELEMENT.RefSeq_ProteinBindingSite__experiment: Provides literature evidence (PMIDs) for protein interactions.
REGULATORY_ELEMENT.RefSeq_NucleotideMotif__note: Describes sequence motifs essential for sequencing analysis.

EXPERIMENT.IntAct_Experiment__full_name: Human-readable name providing context for the proteome experiment.
EXPERIMENT.IntAct_Experiment__imex_id: Unique identifier for web search, selected over redundant 'names' property.
EXPERIMENT.IntAct_Experiment__primary_xref: Links to PubMed IDs for associated literature research.

CLASSIFICATION.names: Primary identifier (NCBITaxon) essential for microbiome organism identification and web search.
CLASSIFICATION.DGIdb_Category__name: Categorizes gene/protein targets relevant for treatment and drug interaction research.
CLASSIFICATION.InterPro_Classification__description: Defines protein function and biological processes crucial for proteome and sequencing analysis.

INTERACTION.names: Unique IntAct identifier essential for web search and literature retrieval.
INTERACTION.IntAct_Interaction__short_label: Displays interacting protein partners, essential for proteome mapping.
INTERACTION.IntAct_Interaction__attributes: Contains experimental details, stoichiometry, and methods relevant for literature research and analysis.
INTERACTION.IntAct_Interaction__secondary_xref: Links to GO terms for functional annotation relevant to proteome research.
INTERACTION.IntAct_Interaction__negative: Distinguishes negative interactions, vital for accurate proteome network analysis.

PROTEIN_FEATURE.UniProt_Feature__id: Unique identifier for the specific protein feature instance.
PROTEIN_FEATURE.UniProt_Feature__location_sequence: Protein accession number essential for sequencing analysis and web search.
PROTEIN_FEATURE.UniProt_Feature__location_begin: Start position coordinate for sequencing analysis.
PROTEIN_FEATURE.UniProt_Feature__location_end: End position coordinate for sequencing analysis.
PROTEIN_FEATURE.InterPro_BindingSite__name: Human-readable name for functional site identification and search.
PROTEIN_FEATURE.InterPro_BindingSite__structure_db_links: PDB structure links crucial for structural analysis and treatment design.
PROTEIN_FEATURE.InterPro_PTM__external_docs: Literature and pathway references for research and treatment context.

GENETIC_VARIATION.names: Standard identifier for the genetic region entity.
GENETIC_VARIATION.RefSeq_SequenceAlteration__dbsnp_rs_id: Specific variant identifier essential for web search and literature lookup.
GENETIC_VARIATION.RefSeq_SequenceAlteration__function: Links genetic variation to disease susceptibility and associated treatments.
GENETIC_VARIATION.RefSeq_SequenceAlteration__experiment: Provides sequencing analysis evidence and literature references (PMIDs).
GENETIC_VARIATION.RefSeq_RecombinationFeature__gene: Associates variation with specific gene symbols for proteome context.
GENETIC_VARIATION.RefSeq_SequenceAlteration__note: Details allele-specific effects and mechanisms relevant to sequencing analysis.

MOBILE_GENETIC_ELEMENT.RefSeq_MobileGeneticElement__id: Unique identifier essential for database linkage and web search.
MOBILE_GENETIC_ELEMENT.RefSeq_MobileGeneticElement__mobile_elem: Classification critical for microbiome and sequencing analysis context.
MOBILE_GENETIC_ELEMENT.RefSeq_MobileGeneticElement__function: Links to literature (PMID) and biological roles relevant to treatments.
MOBILE_GENETIC_ELEMENT.RefSeq_MobileGeneticElement__experiment: Provides evidence codes and sequencing validation data.

CHROMOSOMAL_STRUCTURE.RefSeq_Chromosome__id: Unique RefSeq accession number essential for web search and database linking in sequencing analysis.
CHROMOSOMAL_STRUCTURE.RefSeq_Chromosome__chromosome: Identifies specific chromosome number, crucial for organizing genomic structure in microbiome research.
CHROMOSOMAL_STRUCTURE.RefSeq_Chromosome__start: Genomic start position required for sequencing analysis and mapping proteomic data.
CHROMOSOMAL_STRUCTURE.RefSeq_Chromosome__end: Genomic end position required for sequencing analysis and mapping proteomic data.
CHROMOSOMAL_STRUCTURE.RefSeq_Chromosome__mol_type: Specifies molecule type such as genomic DNA, relevant for distinguishing genetic material in research contexts.

ONTOLOGY.GeneOntology_Term__id: Standard unique identifier required for linking ontology terms to proteome and microbiome data.
ONTOLOGY.GeneOntology_Term__name: Human-readable label essential for web search and entity identification.
ONTOLOGY.GeneOntology_Term__def: Contains definitions and literature citations (PMID) relevant for associated literature research.
ONTOLOGY.GeneOntology_Term__namespace: Categorizes terms into processes or functions, aiding sequencing analysis context.
